title: Accessibility | Apple Developer Documentation - [Hearing](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility\#Hearing)
claim: Transcripts** provide a complete textual description of a video, covering both audible and visual information. Transcripts are great for longer-form media like podcasts and audiobooks where people may want to review content as a whole or highlight the transcript as media is playing.
supporting_text: - **Transcripts** provide a complete textual description of a video, covering both audible and visual information.
